title: Admin presence (who else has this open; in memory only, admins only)

PresenceKind.description: The kind of page: an Inbox member request (Inbox detail and its editor) or a run (the run sheet).

id.description: The request's or run's id; an unknown id is accepted and simply matches nobody.

seq.description: Orders one tab's calls: it grows with every check-in and leave (the leave sends it as `DELETE …&seq=`). A check-in no newer than the tab's leave is ignored for the 60 s lifetime, so one cut off in flight cannot bring the tab back.

PresenceEntry.description: Another admin at the place, once per admin (editing if any of their tabs is); the caller is never listed.

admin.description: The admin's actor id (`discord:<id>`, `tailscale:<login>`, `token`) and the name their sign-in shows.

seen_s.description: Seconds since their latest check-in there.

PresenceHere.description: PUT /api/admin/presence: the check-in's answer, with the cadence the client keeps.

heartbeat_s.description: Check in this often while the page is visible.

ttl_s.description: An entry is gone this long after its last check-in.

PresenceList.description: GET /api/admin/presence?at=<kind>:<id>: a read without checking in.
